pages.title: Empirical Dossier
pages.text: A thick binder of my earliest discoveries - every measurement, every failed run, every note in the margin - bound and sealed in superfluid-cooled pages. Read by a machine, it is a curriculum. Read by me, it is mostly embarrassment and nostalgia in roughly equal parts.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Teaching a machine to study meant giving it something to study. I gathered the three volumes of my empirical notes and preserved them in superfluid helium, so the Research Nexus could read them as I once did - only faster. I have found copies in anomaly vaults too.
Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Anomaly Vault chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Research Synthesis.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Theoretical Dossier.
